observations: Three photos show a used car engine on a paved outdoor surface, likely in a workshop or yard.
The engine has a black plastic cover with 'PORSCHE' embossed vertically on the side.
The engine block is black with visible components like the intake manifold, throttle body, and various hoses and belts.
The engine appears dirty and used, with some grime and wear visible on the components.
A watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is present on all photos.
No visible model number or VIN plate is readable on the engine block or cover.
The seller claims to deal in car spare parts, but the item is clearly a specific engine, not a generic spare part.

claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: The seller's text is general and not specific to this item. The photos show only one engine, not a full range of spare parts.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running or a close-up of the cylinder head, oil pan, and internal components to check for cracks or wear.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from the claimed model or may be a counterfeit
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with the model number or VIN plate, or a photo of the engine's serial number and casting number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown model, which may be lower value

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle
risks.proof: A photo of the engine's serial number and casting number, or a photo of the vehicle it came from, if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, which may reduce value

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the engine block showing the model number or casting number.
Video of the engine running or a close-up of the internal components.
Photo of the engine's serial number and casting number.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
